testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a staged ribbon edit while viewing marking menu customization: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:433:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a staged ribbon edit while viewing marking menu customization ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on Ribbon for an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel without applying ✔ And the user selects the Marking Menu customization tab ✔ Then the marking menu customization controls are displayed ✔ And Apply and cancels remain available ✔ When the user returns to the Ribbon customization tab ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains in the Part Tools target list ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ When the user cancels the customization dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
